en: Sasha, the good news
is you've hit breakfast TV audience
in Europe, so well done for that.
How did you improve in your game
as the match went along tonight?
Well, it was actually, which is funny,
I was practicing quite well here,
which is very different to Canada.
I was practicing terrible,
I was playing terrible,
everything was terrible in Canada.
So I knew that I had to get
into a match with him, obviously,
I've been playing well this season,
but my confidence was not there
because I lost first round of Canada.
It was about finding your rhythm
on the match court,
and I did that, and the first set wasn't great,
but then afterwards,
second and third sets were really high level,
and I'm happy about that.
You had a lot of break points
that didn't go your way.
You managed yourself well,
and you had to match Cam's intensity,
you always do, I guess.
Yeah, I mean, look, the break points
that you have, it's really difficult
to return on the outside against him,
because he has an incredible serve out
wide, and he has a very good serve T,
so it's definitely much more difficult
to win points on that side of the court
than on the deuce side.
But I still, I feel like I didn't play
the break points badly, you know,
I didn't lose them myself.
He was playing really well, you know,
it was a lot of the time, serve plus one,
he was being aggressive in the rallies,
and I knew that I'm going
to get more chances, and yeah,
once I did, I used him.
Super job, mate, well done.
Thank you.
